name: doc_pages
title: Doc Pages
description: One guide per record for the public /docs documentation site. nav_order is a text field holding a numeric string -- the same convention site_routes uses for priority -- so ordering stays a plain sortable string rather than a second numeric type. Seeded content: visitors only ever read these through /docs and /docs/{slug}.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.help: Groups this page under a heading in the sidebar

fields.name: nav_order
fields.label: Nav Order
fields.help: Numeric string; pages sort ascending by this value within their category and across the prev/next sequence

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.help: One line shown in search results and previews

fields.name: content
fields.label: Content
fields.help: Markdown, rendered through the shared /markdown renderer
